verdict.rationale: Vast.ai exposes a CLI/SDK/REST API, scoped API keys for CI/CD, and an 'agent skill' letting AI coding assistants drive the platform (create instances, deploy endpoints, manage keys) — all usable to script automations, and Serverless endpoints let workloads run without manual GPU management. However, there is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, cron/trigger system, or persistent background job orchestration that runs autonomously without an external driver; automation depends on the user's own agent/script staying alive. Missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger mechanism, evidence of long-running autonomous background jobs, and independent confirmation of the agent-skill working unattended in production.
